text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Demonstrating her true capability in the 
Yayoi Sho, Satono Crown shows her 
confidence for the Classic Triple Crown to 
the press. And to her—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume of the same generation... 
Some were crushed. Some resolved never to 
give up and threw themselves into 
training. And then—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There were those who burned with quiet 
determination, aiming to defeat her and 
draw closer to the title of the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown route, swirling 
with the hopes of a generation. Its first 
chapter, the Satsuki Sho, is about to 
begin—
